label: CASH FLOWS FROM OPERATING ACTIVITIES
notes: Excel section header. Omitted from JSON.

label: Income (loss) before income tax
source: Posted GL monthly totals for all account_type.financial_statement=profit_and_loss
sign: P&L nature (credit nature = credit-debit; else debit-credit)
notes: Proxy for IBT until a tax expense line is mapped. Includes depreciation and interest; those are adjusted on later lines.

label: Adjustments for:
notes: Excel subsection header. Omitted from JSON.

label: Depreciation and amortization
source: P&L accounts whose name/line/report contains DEPRECIATION or AMORTIZATION
notes: CIFI report/line DEPRECIATION on COS; BOC; G&A.

label: Interest expense
source: P&L accounts whose name/line/report contains INTEREST EXPENSE (not INTEREST INCOME)
notes: Also used to compute financing interest_paid.

label: Retirement Cost
source: P&L accounts whose name/line/report contains RETIREMENT

label: Loss on sale or disposal of PPE
source: P&L name/line/report contains LOSS and (SALE or DISPOSAL) and PPE

label: Unrealized loss on foreign exchange
source: P&L name/line/report contains UNREALIZED and (LOSS) and (FOREIGN or FOREX or FX or EXCHANGE)

label: Bad debt expense or impairment loss
source: P&L name/line/report contains BAD DEBT or IMPAIRMENT (and not REVERSAL)

label: Loss on obsolete inventory
source: P&L name/line/report contains OBSOLETE and INVENTORY

label: Gain on sale or disposal of PPE
source: P&L name/line/report contains GAIN and (SALE or DISPOSAL) and PPE

label: Unrealized gain on foreign exchange
source: P&L name/line/report contains UNREALIZED and GAIN and (FOREIGN or FOREX or FX or EXCHANGE)

label: Gain on insurance claims
source: P&L name/line/report contains INSURANCE and GAIN

label: Interest income
source: P&L accounts whose name/line/report contains INTEREST INCOME

label: Gain on reversal of bad debts expense
source: P&L name/line/report contains REVERSAL and (BAD DEBT or IMPAIRMENT)

label: Operating gain (loss) before working capital changes
source: income_before_tax + all adjustment lines

label: Changes in:
notes: Excel subsection header. Omitted from JSON.

label: Trade receivables
source: BS CIFI line_name=TRADE RECEIVABLES

label: Other receivables
source: BS CIFI line_name=RECEIVABLE - OTHERS

label: Inventories
source: BS CIFI line_name=INVENTORIES

label: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
source: BS CIFI PREPAID TAXES / PREPAID EXPENSES or category current_asset/prepayment (not cash/AR/inventory)

label: Trade payables and accrued expenses
source: BS CIFI TRADE PAYABLES + PAYABLE - OTHERS (not ADVANCES - OTHERS) + TAXES PAYABLE / PREMIUMS PAYABLE / PROVISION FOR TAX LIABILITY

label: Other current liabilities
source: BS CIFI OTHER CURRENT LIABILITIES or LEASE LIABILITY - CURRENT

label: Trust Receipts Loans
source: Account name/line contains TRUST RECEIPT

label: Other noncurrent liabilities
source: BS CIFI line_name=OTHER NONCURRENT LIABILITIES
notes: Excel parks this under operating changes.

label: Interest received
source: + interest income P&L signed (cash assumed = P&L)
notes: Opposite of the interest_income adjustment line.

label: Interest paid
source: Always 0
notes: Excel row 34 is blank for current year; paid interest is under financing.

label: Net cash provided by operating activities
source: operating_before_wc + WC change lines + interest_received + interest_paid_operating

label: CASH FLOWS FROM INVESTING ACTIVITIES
notes: Excel section header. Omitted from JSON.

label: Changes in:
notes: Excel subsection header. Omitted from JSON.

label: Investments
source: BS name/line/detail contains INVESTMENT (not PPE)

label: Security deposits
source: BS name/line/detail contains SECURITY DEPOSIT

label: Acquisitions/additions to PPE
source: -(Δ net PPE + depreciation add-back). Net PPE = CIFI line PPE or RIGHT-OF USE; Δ = credit-debit
sign: credit-debit on PPE minus depreciation YTD
notes: Avoids double-counting accum-dep / dep expense. No disposal proceeds split yet.

label: Proceeds from insurance claim
source: P&L/BS name contains INSURANCE and (PROCEED or CLAIM) and not GAIN
notes: 0 if no matching account. Gain on insurance stays in operating adjustments.

label: Dividends received
source: P&L name/line/report contains DIVIDEND and RECEIV

label: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities
source: investments + security_deposits + ppe_acquisitions + proceeds_insurance + dividends_received

label: CASH FLOWS FROM FINANCING ACTIVITIES
notes: Excel section header. Omitted from JSON.

label: Net proceeds (repayment) of bank notes/loans
source: BS CIFI SHORT TERM LOANS + LONG TERM LOANS

label: Common Shares
source: BS CIFI PAID UP CAPITAL and name/detail does not contain PREFERRED

label: Preferred Shares
source: BS CIFI PAID UP CAPITAL and name/detail contains PREFERRED

label: Advances from stockholders
source: BS CIFI PAYABLE - OTHERS and detail ADVANCES - OTHERS (due to related parties)

label: Interest paid
source: - interest expense P&L signed

label: Dividends paid
source: P&L/equity name contains DIVIDEND and PAID

label: Net cash provided by financing activities
source: bank_loans + common_shares + preferred_shares + advances_stockholders + interest_paid + dividends_paid

label: NET INCREASE (DECREASE) IN CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS
source: net_operating + net_investing + net_financing
notes: Excel row 52. Each month cell is YTD from date_from.

label: CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS AT BEGINNING OF PERIOD
source: BS CIFI CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS signed balance for posted dates before date_from
sign: P&L/BS nature (cash is debit nature: debit-credit)
notes: Same value on every month column.

label: CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS AT END OF PERIOD
source: beginning_cash + net_increase

label: Month columns
source: Months that intersect date_from..date_to
notes: Each cell is YTD from date_from through that month (last month clipped by date_to).

label: Optional clinic filter
source: 1 mobile / 2 oakridge / 3 mactan / 4 consolacion / 7 mantlewood
notes: Omit to sum all five clinics.

label: Posted GL only
source: General_ledger::get_posted_monthly_totals + get_posted_account_totals_before
notes: No journal dump. COA from Account_type::get_balance_sheet_accounts plus P&L report_name.
